general.title: General
general.reconnectHint: Tabs from the last session come back connected, ready to query.
general.updatesHint: Updates are signed and verified before they install; nothing installs without your click.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.themeHint: System follows your operating system's light or dark mode.
appearance.zoomHint: Scales the whole interface. {{zoomOut}} zooms out, {{reset}} restores the actual size.
appearance.accentHint: Used for selection, focus and primary actions.
appearance.darkStyleHint: Navy is close to Compass; pure black suits OLED screens and dark rooms.
appearance.sidebarDensityHint: Compact fits more connections and collections on screen.
appearance.sidebarSizesHint: Show database sizes and document counts beside each name.
appearance.uiFontHint: The system font matches other apps on your computer.

editor.title: Editors
editor.description: Documents, pipelines and other multi-line editors.
editor.fontSizeHint: Query bar fields keep their compact size.
editor.monoFontHint: Used by the results, editors and shell. Leave empty for the bundled IBM Plex Mono.

shell.title: Shell
shell.description: The mongosh terminal. Changes apply to open shells too.
shell.scrollbackHint: Lines kept above the visible output.

results.title: Results
results.description: How query and aggregation results are loaded and shown.
results.viewHint: Each tab can still switch view.
results.batchSizeHint: Fetched from the server each time you scroll to the end. Larger pages mean fewer round trips.
results.maxRowsHint: Beyond this, a result stops loading and shows that it was truncated.
results.densityHint: How tall table rows are: compact fits more documents on screen.
results.confirmDeleteHint: When off, a document is deleted at once and can be restored from the notification for a few seconds.
results.datesHint: How the table shows dates. Editors keep ISODate in UTC, so nothing changes in the data.

data.title: Query history
data.description: Recent queries are kept on this computer only.
data.clearHistoryHint: Forgets the recent queries of every collection. Saved queries stay.

tools.title: Bundled tools
tools.databaseToolsHint: mongodump and mongorestore, used for backups and restores.

keyboard.title: Keyboard shortcuts
keyboard.description: Click a shortcut and press new keys. Each can go back to its default.

about.title: About
about.tagline: An open source desktop client for MongoDB.

reset.title: Reset
reset.label: Reset all settings
reset.hint: Restores every setting on these pages to its default. Connections, history and backups are not affected.
reset.confirmDescription: Every setting goes back to its default value. Your connections, saved queries and backups are kept.

ai.title: AI assistant
ai.description: Describe the documents you want and a model writes the query. It sees field names and types, never your data, and the query runs only when you choose.
ai.enabledHint: Adds Ask AI to the query bar (⌘I or Ctrl I).

engineHint.local: A model downloaded below, run offline inside odin-db.
engineHint.ollama: A model you already run in Ollama.

ai.modelsHint: This computer has {{memory}} GB of memory. Models on disk: {{used}}.

ollama.pullHint: Pull a model in Ollama first, e.g. ollama pull qwen2.5-coder:1.5b.

notes.qwen2.5-coder-0.5b: The smallest and quickest; fine for simple filters on older machines.
notes.qwen2.5-coder-1.5b: Trained on code: the best balance of accuracy and speed for queries.
notes.qwen3.5-2b: A newer general model; less precise than the coder models on queries.
notes.qwen3.5-4b: The most accurate here, about twice as slow as the 1.5B.
notes.llama-3.2-3b: Meta's general model; decent, but slower than Qwen Coder 1.5B and less precise.
notes.phi-4-mini: Microsoft's reasoning-oriented model; accurate enough, but the slowest here.

table.guide: Accuracy is the share of 105 test requests answered with exactly the right query; time per query was measured on an Apple M3 and grows on slower machines. Larger models are more accurate but slower: the recommended one is the best balance for this computer.
